facts.text: 19.7-Meter UltraFlex Solar Arrays was deployed at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit during Dawn in 2007.
Two massive 8.3 x 2.3 m deployable solar wings spanning 19.7 meters tip-to-tip, generating 10,000 W at Earth and 1,300 W in the asteroid belt.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Powered deep-space ion engines at 3 AU from the Sun using advanced high-efficiency triple-junction solar cells.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit.
Largest solar arrays flown on an interplanetary robotic science mission at the time.
